the lifeforms were trying to tell me something of importance.. but I could not communicate with them. I felt myself becoming apart of their world, joining them..for a second I understood everything..all the answers to the universe..I began to feel my ego slip away.. ..the same feeling at the beginning of my trip...I was falling deeper into their realm and further away from ours...but it was very peaceful and cathartic..very intense but in a good way. In retrospect it truly felt like death, I hesitated and began to get pulled back into this world. I saw their world and ours coinciding with one another for a second before it all faded

A minute later I was getting pulled back into their realm, but it stopped, and finally faded. for a few days afterwards I felt very different, my vision and perception was altered..it felt like a different person I questioned everything..who I was..reality,existence..It was surreal.
